release-body.text: The manifest version selects the changelog section, which opens the body; the stable text follows. The entity diagram shows version to section to body. Empty sections stop publication.

archive-contents.text: Both archives with checksums, identities verified, shipped instructions byte-equal to the source, and the README row describing the new purpose.

check-cases.text: Four wrong-input refusals, three missing-or-empty refusals with the loud message, three passing compositions with exact bodies, and one already-published pass without recreating.
